diagnostic_format: [ErrorType] File "<filename>", line X, col Y: <Exact Message>

tests.name: lexical closure capture
tests.source_code:
To make_adder with offset:
    To add with value:
        Give back value plus offset.
    End function.
    Give back add.
End function.
Let add_three be make_adder(3).
Say add_three(4).

End function.

tests.name: Ask reads stdin and preserves prompt
tests.source_code:
Ask "Name? " and save the answer as name.
Say "Hello {name}".

tests.name: file write append read round trip
tests.source_code:
Write "one" to the file "data.txt".
Append " two" to the file "data.txt".
Read the file "data.txt" into contents.
Say contents.

tests.name: relative local module import
tests.source_code:
Use the module "helpers.tell" as helpers.
Say helpers.add(2, 3).

files.modules/helpers.tell:
To add with left and right:
    Give back left plus right.
End function.

tests.name: typed list set add and remove
tests.source_code:
Let values be [1, 2].
Set values[1] to 9.
Set the item at position 0 in values to 7.
Add 3 to values.
Remove 9 from values.
Say values.

tests.name: Call Run and Tell method discard return values
tests.source_code:
To emit with text:
    Say text.
    Give back "ignored".
End function.
Call emit with "called".
Run emit with "run".
Create a class called Counter:
    When creating a Counter:
        Remember 1 as this.value.
    End constructor.
    To increment:
        Remember this.value plus 1 as this.value.
        Give back "ignored".
    End function.
End class.
Let counter be a new Counter.
Tell counter to increment.
Say counter.value.

tests.name: built-in library import alias
tests.source_code:
Use the math library as maths.
Say maths.floor(2.9).
